# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 蹈也。从足步聲。
As per 夋# as described in 俊 (stand erect) + 足 leg/foot → *stand with the feet together* → *squat* (← lower the body, but keep the back erect/straight). For "squat," compare 蹲.

As per 甬# (run through) + 足 leg/foot → stamp the ground (energetically, as though to run through it) then *jump/spring/rise up* (compare 動 and 勇) → *dance* → *manipulate* (← make another dance to one's tune).
跳也。从足甬聲。

沓# pile + 足 leg/foot → footsteps piled upon each other → *stamp/tread*; *step/stand on*; *set foot on*; *stand firm* → *be based on* → *experience*; *go through* (← based on what one has experienced or gone through).
As per 戔# (fine/slight) + 足 leg/foot → take fine steps (compare 前) → *step*/*tread* (on) → *put into practice*; *perform* (← trample an object for a specific purpose).
履也。从足戔聲。
足跌也。从足委聲。
As per 卓# (rise above) + 足 leg/foot → leap high (compare 逴 and 躍) → *great distance* (← high leap) → *surpass*; *exceed* → *excel*.
踶也。从足㔬聲。
As per 昔# (pile) + 足 leg/foot → footprints figuratively piled atop each other in treading/trampling the same spot → *tread*; *trample*. Compare 蹠.
長脛行也。从足㫺聲。一曰踧踖。
As per 果# (round) + 足 leg/foot → (the round) *anklebone* → *ankle*.
足踝也。从足果聲。
As per 居# (settle/set in place) + 足 leg/foot → *crouch*; *squat*. *Arrogant* is a borrowed meaning, via 倨.
蹲也。从足居聲。
As per 知# (direct) + 足 leg/foot → walk in place (the legs trampling the same spot directly below) → *make halting progress*.
宛# bend + 足 leg/foot → *bend/stoop* → *writhe*; *squirm*; *struggle* (← contort ← bend).
卷# curl + 足 leg/foot → assume a *curled* posture.
As per 咅# (spread) + 足 leg/foot → *stumble* and *fall prone* (← body spread on the ground). Compare 蹁.
僵也。从足咅聲。《春秋傳》曰：“晉人踣之。”
觸也。从足卒聲。一曰駭也。一曰蒼踤。
As per 奇# (lean) + 足 leg/foot → *lame leg* (← leg that splays out at an angle ).
一足也。从足奇聲。

As per 叔# (slender and pendent) + 足 leg/foot → crippled leg (hanging from the torso) → *take short steps* (← restricted length of the steps of one with a crippled leg; compare 蹜). *Level* is a borrowed meaning.
行平易也。从足叔聲。《詩》曰：“踧踧周道。”
As per 宗# (link) + 足 leg/foot → link formed by a trail of *footprints* → *traces*; *tracks*. Compare 迹, 跡, 蹟 and 蹤.
兪# remove + 足 leg/foot → pass/cross over (← remove oneself to a different location) → *exceed* → *even more/further*. Compare 逾.
越也。从足俞聲。
As per 重# (run through) + 足 leg/foot → *heel* (exerting heavy pressure on the ground, as though to run through it).
追也。从足重聲。一曰往來皃。
躛也。从足是聲。
踸踔，行無常皃。从足甚聲。
跌踼也。从足昜聲。一曰搶也。
As per 禹# (wind/bend) + 足 leg/foot → *hunch over*; *bend down* (compare 偊).
䟽行皃。从足禹聲。《詩》曰：“獨行踽踽。”
As per 扁# (spread, but remain in contact) + 足 leg/foot → *totter*; *stumble* (← feet dragging on the ground). Compare 踣.
足不正也。从足扁聲。一曰拖後足馬。讀若苹。或曰徧。
柔# soft + 足 leg/foot → *trample* (clay, foodstuffs etc.) in order to soften → *tread*; *step on*.
As per 帝# (unify) + 足 leg/foot → the single-unit capsule of a horse's *hoof*. Compare 蹢.
As per the upper element# of 寒 (raise in layers) + 足 leg/foot → *lameness* forcing one to raise one's leg in slow, layered motions → a *cripple*. Also, *suffer* and *be troubled*.
跛也。从足，寒省聲。
舀# dip + 足 leg/foot → *stamp* the feet. In contemporary Japanese usage, 蹈 is generally replaced by 踏.
踐也。从足舀聲。
As per 差# (irregular) + 足 leg/foot → *stumble* over irregular ground → *mistake/failure* (in the course of doing something).
蹉跎，失時也。从足差聲。
As per 奚# (aligned) + 足 leg/foot → aligned (foot)paths/lanes (compare 蹊) → *path*; *lane*. Compare 徯.
The right-hand element# described in 榻 (press flat) + 足 leg/foot → *step/tread*, the sole pressed flat against the ground. Compare 踏.
踐也。从足𦐇聲。
As per 倉# (pile) + 足 leg/foot → *move* (rapidly), piling up the number of steps taken. *Stagger* is a borrowed meaning.
動也。从足倉聲。
跋也。从足眞聲。
足也。从足虒聲。
As per 脊# (jagged) + 足 leg/foot → *take short, irregular steps*; *walk stealthily*.
小步也。从足𦟝聲。《詩》曰：“不敢不蹐。”
As per 畢# (split away) + 足 leg/foot (→ action indicator) → *clear the way for an imperial/noble procession* (← clear the way ← split a path).
As per 戚# (slender) + 足 leg/foot → slender, taut leg muscles (compare 蹴) → *urgent* (← taut condition/situation). *Knit the brows* and *scowl* are borrowed meanings via 顰.
迫也。从足戚聲。臣鉉等案：李善《文選注》通蹴字。
踶也。从足帶聲。
As per 宿# (shrink) + 足 leg/foot → *take short steps* (compare 踧) in walking carefully.

As per 責# (pile) + 足 leg/foot → tread upon *footprints* in following one who has gone ahead, creating a figurative pile → *follow (a precedent/rule)*; *trace one's steps*. Also, *site* and *remains* (← vestiges; compare 跡 and 迹, as well as 踪 and 蹤).

As per 庶# (pile) + 足 leg/foot → footprints figuratively piled atop each other in treading/trampling the same spot (compare 迹, 跡 and 蹟) → *tread/trample* → *sole of the foot* (used in treading/trampling). For the latter meaning, compare 跖.
楚人謂跳躍曰蹠。从足庶聲。
As per 啇# (variant of 啻) (unify) + 足 leg/foot → *hoof* (the single unit of a horse's "foot"; compare 蹄). Also, *take a few steps then stop* (← clearly demarcated units of movement).
住足也。从足，適省聲。或曰蹢躅。賈侍中說：足垢也。
As per 㒼# as described in 滿 (cover/fill completely) + 足 leg/foot → cover an object in passing over it → *coil about*; *lie/crawl flat on one's stomach*. Also, *stagger*.
從# follow + 足 leg/foot → *footprints* following one after the other → *traces*; *tracks*. Compare 迹, 跡, 蹟 and 踪.
踶也。从足敝聲。一曰跛也。
蹭蹬也。从足登聲。
蹭蹬，失道也。从足曾聲。
蹁蹮，旋行。从足䙴聲。
As per 番# (spread) + 足 leg/foot → spread *paw* → *paw meat*.
尊# settle + 足 leg/foot → settle into a *squat/crouch* (compare 踆).
踞也。从足尊聲。
As per 就# (contract) + 足 leg/foot → contract the leg muscles (compare 蹙) in kicking/trampling → *kick*; *tread on*; *trample*.
躡也。从足就聲。
As per 厥# (seizure) + 足 leg/foot → *stumble*/*fall* (to the ground) in suffering a seizure → *trip* → *fell* (an enemy/opponent) → *kill*. Also, *leap* (← fly forward in being tripped).
僵也。从足厥聲。一曰跳也。亦讀若橜。
轢也。从足㷠聲。
喬# tall and limber + 足 leg/foot → arch the feet and *stand tiptoe*. Also, high-soled straw *sandals* used in mountain climbing (compare 屩 and 屨).
舉足行高也。从足喬聲。《詩》曰：“小子蹻蹻。”
As per 菐# as described in 僕 (rough) + 足 leg/foot → *web* (← rough feet of a waterfowl).
As per 喿# as described in 操 (activity taking place above) + 足 leg/foot → leg scratching irritably at the ground below (compare 騷) → *irritability*; *anxiety*; *noisy*.
As per 辟# (spread) + 足 leg/foot → spread one's weakened legs for balance in order to *shuffle (along)* → a *cripple*.
As per 蜀# (adhere) + 足 leg/foot → *walk carefully*, then *stop and stand rigid*. Compare 豎 and 竪.
蹢躅也。从足蜀聲。
As per 著# (compilation) + 足 leg/foot → footsteps figuratively piled in treading the same spot in hesitation → *hesitate*.
壽# long span + 足 leg/foot → pace back and forth at length → *hesitate*. Compare 佻.
As per 齊# (align) + 足 leg/foot → *ascend/rise/climb (high)* by carefully aligning one's steps.
登也。从足齊聲。《商書》曰：“予顚躋。”
As per 翟# (rise high) + 足 leg/foot → *leap/jump* high into the air (compare 跳) → *spring up* → *dance*.
迅也。从足翟聲。

As per 巤# as described in 獵 (bind) + 足 leg/foot → bind the legs with protective material in crossing a river or other obstacle → *cross over*; *step across* → *exceed* . Also, *step on the foot of a person walking ahead of one*.
As per 鄭# (extend downward) + 足 leg/foot → *squat* → *remain still*.
As per 質# (split) + 足 leg/foot → legs that split, causing one to *stumble* and *fall* (down) → *fail*.
跲也。从足質聲。《詩》曰：“載躓其尾。”
Originally 足 leg/foot + 展# (flatten) → *follow* the path of another, trampling vegetation underfoot → *trample*; *go about*. 展 came to be written 廛.
踐也。从足廛聲。
廚 here a variant form of 尌# (set/stand in place) + 足 leg/foot → *dawdle* (compare 逗) → *hesitate*.
As per the lower element# described in 藺 (link in formation) + 足 leg/foot → *trample* an object into (a string of) small pieces.
衞也。从足衞聲。
As per 聶# (press together) + 足 leg/foot → *step/tread on* → *pursue*; *track*; *follow* (← figuratively or actually press the feet into the tracks left by the prey one is pursuing ).
蹈也。从足聶聲。
行皃。从足瞿聲。

As per 麗# (neatly aligned) + 足 leg/foot → footwear aligned with the feet in being slipped over the toes (not covering the foot entirely) → *sandal*. The feet were then dragged over a surface in performing a dance; compare 屣.
舞履也。从足麗聲。
As per 矍# (enclose in the hands) + 足 leg/foot → *quick steps* such as taken in one's hand by a captive bird in attempting to escape → *short steps*.
足躩如也。从足矍聲。
A depiction of a *pregnant* woman, the fetus adhering within her womb → *body*; *core/center*; *content of an object*.
躳也。象人之身。从人𠂆聲。凡身之屬皆从身。
身 body + 弓# bow → bend the *body* in a position resembling a curved bow → *self*; *(by) oneself*.
身也。从身从呂。
美 beauty + 身 body → (figurative) decoration of the body → *discipline*; *breeding*.
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 身 body → curved/bent *body*.
體也。从身區聲。
A depiction of the frame of a *vehicle* with dual seats → *wheel*; *wheel-shaped object*; *automobile*.
輿輪之緫名。夏后時奚仲所造。象形。凡車之屬皆从車。

As per 乚# a variant form of 乙 (rise and hit a blocking element) + 車 vehicle → run over and *crush* an object, reducing it in size. Also, *grate* (← grating sound made in running something over) → *creak*; *squeak*.
𨋚也。从車乙聲。
As per 九# (bump up against and bend/curve) + 車 vehicle → *rut* (← marks left in the earth by a vehicle's rotating wheels).
車徹也。从車九聲。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 車 vehicle + an obsolete element indicating "wrap" → circular military encampment (compare 營) formed by chariots → *army* → *soldier*; *battle*.
圜圍也。四千人爲軍。从車，从包省。軍，兵車也。
車軸耑也。从車，象形。杜林說。
As per 兀# (raise; rise) + 車 vehicle → the *upward curving shafts* of a vehicle's crossbar. Also, the *linchpin* that crosses the shafts (compare 輗).
車輨也。从車大聲。
干# thick bar + 車 vehicle → long, upward-curving shafts attached to a *cart* → *rise high*; *eaves* (← shape association) → *house*; *counter for houses*.
曲輈藩車。从車干聲。
車軾前也。从車凡聲。《周禮》曰：“立當前軓。”
刃# (cut with a) blade + 車 vehicle → cut the free movement of a vehicle by blocking the wheels → *block*; *wheel lock*.
礙車也。从車刃聲。
紡車也。一曰一輪車。从車㞷聲。讀若狂。
兵車也。从車屯聲。
厄 here an abbreviated form# of 扼 (grip tightly) + 車 vehicle → *yoke* gripping the throat of a beast of burden.
驂馬内轡繫軾前者。从車内聲。《詩》曰：“𣵽以𧥎軜。”
長轂之軝也，以朱約之。从車氏聲。《詩》曰：“約軝錯衡。”

Originally, 車 vehicle + 耎# (soft) → large, wheeled plow used to turn up soft soil (lying beneath the hard upper layer) → *soft*. For the idea of softness vis–à–vis the turning of soil, compare 農. 軟 replaces 耎 with 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure (bend → pliable), and this became the standard form of the character.
軶下曲者。从車句聲。
大車後也。从車氐聲。
車轖閒橫木。从車令聲。
As per the right-hand element# as described in 珍 (fullness) + 車 vehicle → *board stretched fully across the back of a vehicle or carriage*.
車後橫木也。从車㐱聲。
車戾也。从車匡聲。
反推車，令有所付也。从車从付。讀若胥。
轅前也。从車戹聲。
出，將有事於道，必先告其神，立壇四通，樹茅以依神，爲軷。旣祭軷，轢於牲而行，爲範軷。《詩》曰：“取羝以軷。”从車犮聲。
As per 由# (pass/run through) + 車 vehicle → *axle*/*shaft* running the width of a vehicle → *axis* → *scroll* (← similarity of shape).
持輪也。从車由聲。
As per 只# (dispersal) + 車 vehicle → *endpoint of an axle* (← point of a vehicle dispersed the greatest distance).
車輪小穿也。从車只聲。
As per 召# (curve) + 車 vehicle → *small, open-air vehicle* with curved shafts.
小車也。从車召聲。
As per 可# (bend) + 車 vehicle → use an angled implement to *set a vehicle's axle in place* with a tremendous creaking noise → *creaking vehicle*.
接軸車也。从車可聲。
失# lose + 車 vehicle → rushing vehicle that is quickly lost to sight → *surpass*; *disappear*. *Rut* is a borrowed meaning.
車相出也。从車失聲。
As per 式# (straight) + 車 vehicle → straight, *horizontal bar* at the front of a vehicle or conveyance.
車前也。从車式聲。
輜車也。从車并聲。
